brief:
Pro-Palestine activists gathered outside the Copenhagen headquarters of Danish shipping company Maersk to demonstrate against the firm's alleged involvement in transporting military goods, the Shehab Wire reported. Protesters accused Maersk of facilitating the movement of military equipment and components connected to the Israeli military.

The action represents part of a broader campaign by Palestinian solidarity groups targeting international logistics companies over their role in arms transfers. Activists have increasingly focused pressure on shipping firms and freight operators they say enable weapons supplies to Israel's armed forces.

title: Pro-Palestine activists protest Maersk's military shipments to Israel
